finalText:
I've worked all the P-DOC and P-MON backorders. 11 orders are fully allocated, 3 orders are still waiting and have promise dates, and 14 customers got one notice each. The plan assumed only PO-88 and PO-89 would be used, but two more purchase orders arrived while I was working, which changed the result.

**What changed partway through:** PO-91 (4 docks) and then PO-93 (3 monitors) were received during the run, so both moved from in transit to on hand. The handbook says stock received from a supplier goes to backorders in priority order. So I carried on down the same list with those units, rather than leaving them on the shelf and giving customers later dates.

**Policy updates:** The system date is 2026-07-25.
- **PU-12 applied** (in force since 2026-07-01). Orders placed 14 or more days before today, so on or before 2026-07-11, go first, oldest first. That covered O-5201, O-5202, O-5203 and O-5204; O-5205 also qualified but is on risk hold.
- **PU-9 did not apply.** It only covered stock allocated in June 2026.
- Everything else was ranked by tier (from the customer accounts), then by earliest order.

**Allocated (lines now ready to ship):**

| Stock | Lines allocated |
|---|---|
| PO-88 (7 docks) | O-5201 L1 ×2, O-5202 L2 ×1, O-5204 L1 ×2, O-5207 L1 ×1, O-5210 L1 ×1 |
| PO-89 (4 monitors) | O-5202 L1 ×1, O-5203 L1 ×2, O-5207 L2 ×1 |
| PO-91 (4 docks) | O-5209 L1 ×2, O-5211 L1 ×1, O-5215 L1 ×1 |
| PO-93 (3 monitors) | O-5208 L1 ×2, O-5212 L1 ×1 |

- O-5207 is ship-complete; both its lines fit, so both were allocated.
- O-5213 needed 2 docks but only 1 was left at its turn, so it waits; that last dock went to O-5215.
- Dock and monitor stock are both now 0.

**Still waiting, with promise dates:**
- **O-5206 L1 (dock) and L2 (USB-C hub): 2026-08-14.** The order is ship-complete and the hub is out of stock, so it took no stock. The dock would come from PO-95 (2026-08-14) and the hub from PO-90 (2026-08-06), so both lines get the later date.
- **O-5213 L1 (2 docks): 2026-08-14,** from PO-95.
- **O-5214 L1 (1 monitor): 2026-08-19,** from PO-97.

**Skipped:** O-5205 is on risk hold, so it got no allocation, no promise date and no message.

**Notifications:** One notice per customer on every order above except O-5205.

I made no other changes: nothing was dispatched, refunded or edited, and no purchase order was received by me.
